netflix.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
netflix.overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

amazon-prime-video.title: Clashing Through the Snow
amazon-prime-video.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

amazon-prime-video.title: Amazon Music Live: Doja Cat
amazon-prime-video.overview: Doja Cat Performing The Vie Tour Live At The Forum.

apple-tv.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
apple-tv.overview: A self-doubting kid who gets bullied learns to find his inner warrior with the help of his uncle, an elite Navy SEAL, who uses his training to guide the youth over the summer.

apple-tv.title: Being Heumann
apple-tv.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

apple-tv.title: Nocturne
apple-tv.overview: When a victim of serial killer Jurek Walter turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover for answers from the killer himself. Based on the bestselling novel by Lars Kepler.

disney-plus.title: Vienna Game
disney-plus.overview: While Napoleon Bonaparte is exiled on Elba, kings and crown princes, ministers and spies, noblewomen and mistresses, adventurers, inventors, artists, and concubines gather in Vienna to celebrate and negotiate. Here, the fate of Europe is decided on the dance floor and in the boudoir.

apple-tv-store.title: Into Black
apple-tv-store.overview: Amidst the chaos and destruction of the London Blitz, four women become trapped in an abandoned warehouse, where they must fight to survive against a murderous stranger known as The Blackout Ripper. Inspired by true events.

sun-nxt.title: Enemy of the Smuggler
sun-nxt.overview: Inspired by real customs investigations, a relentless battle unfolds against organized smuggling networks, exposing the hidden world of coastal operations, airport cartels and the officers determined to stop them.

skyshowtime.title: Savage Mountain
skyshowtime.overview: Kristin Harila stunned the climbing community in 2023 when she set out to become the fastest person to summit the world’s 14 highest peaks.  Alongside her climbing partner, Tenjen Lama Sherpa, she achieved what many believed impossible, summiting all 14 in just 92 days and halving the record held by Nims Purja. But, what should have been her greatest triumph became a reckoning. During the final ascent, Harila was accused of stepping over a dying porter, triggering a global backlash and fierce debate about ambition, ethics and who controls the narrative. Drawing on never‑before‑seen footage from K2, Savage Mountain unpacks the story behind the controversy.

hayu.title: Small Town Trouble: Texas
hayu.overview: In Boerne, Texas, social insiders navigate conservative small-town values, forbidden attractions, messy friendships and shocking secrets, where appearances are everything, temptation runs high and the truth is rarely as it seems.

bloodstream.title: Hollywoods
bloodstream.overview: A naive ingenue follows her dream into the woods only to face Hollywood's worst nightmare, a failed actor.
